data.theme: Gender Differences in Engineering Competencies and Self-Efficacy
data.definition: The exploration of differences between male and female engineering students in terms of self-efficacy, competencies, affective traits, and academic performance. This includes studies investigating gendered experiences, self-efficacy gaps, and their implications for engineering education and career outcomes.
subthemes: Self-efficacy gaps between male and female students
Impact of gender on academic performance and retention

data.theme: Sustainability and Ethics Competencies in Engineering Education
data.definition: The integration of sustainability, ethics, and social responsibility into engineering curricula, and the assessment of these competencies among engineering students. This theme includes the development of tools and frameworks to measure students' understanding and application of ethical principles and sustainability practices.
subthemes: Curricular integration of sustainability and ethics
Assessment of ethical reasoning in engineering

data.theme: Innovation and Entrepreneurship Competencies in Engineering
data.definition: The measurement and development of innovation self-efficacy and entrepreneurial competencies among engineering students. This includes the creation and validation of scales to assess these competencies and their role in career development and engineering practice.

data.theme: Measurement Invariance and Fairness in Engineering Education Assessments
data.definition: The examination of whether assessment instruments function similarly across different subpopulations of engineering students, such as first-generation college students or underrepresented groups. This theme includes studies on fairness, equity, and the development of inclusive assessment practices in engineering education.

data.theme: Metacognitive and Learning Orientation Tools in Engineering Education
data.definition: The creation and validation of tools designed to measure metacognitive skills, learning orientations, and self-regulated learning among engineering students. This theme includes the development of instruments to assess how students plan, monitor, and evaluate their own learning processes in engineering contexts.
